name: Notice Five Things
description: A gentle noticing game: five things you see, four sounds or movements, three you feel, then two colours and a breath.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: A five-step noticing game on Guided Pause.
help.goal: There is nothing to finish and no right answers. Notice what you notice.
howToPlay: Press Begin when you are ready.
Look, listen or feel as each step suggests. Say the answers in your head or aloud.
Press Next to skip a step, or Back to repeat one.
tips: If a step does not suit you, skip it. This is a game for a break, not advice.
